data.name: River Traveler
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, as a free action, you can grant yourself and any allies within 30 feet of you a swim speed of 60 feet. This effect lasts for %1 rounds or until you dismiss it as a free action, whichever comes first. Your allies must remain within 30 feet of you or lose this benefit. In addition, you gain a +2 profane or sacred bonus (of the same type as that provided by your obedience) on saves against spells with the water descriptor.
